title: Marketing Assistant/Analyst I
description:
- Marketing Assistant/Analyst I (UK) (Internal role specification: Marketing Operations Associate)
- Location: Northwich, United Kingdom
- Duration: 1 year contract with potential for extension
- Pay Rate: £16.00 / hour (GBP)

Core Responsibilities
- EPIC / EBS Process Ownership: Drive and manage end-to-end system operations for creating, adjusting, and maintaining part numbers and records in internal systems (EPIC and EBS). Ensure data accuracy, complete information submissions, track approvals, and resolve system workflow bottlenecks.
- Product Management Support: Provide operational support to the Product Management team by tracking agreed actions, following up on cross-functional deliverables, maintaining documentation, and ensuring project timelines are met.

Key Qualifications & Requirements
- System & Process Proficiency: Hands-on experience navigating business systems and structured approval processes (e.g., ERP platforms like SAP).
- Workflow Coordination: Proven ability to manage multi-step, detailed processes across different systems and cross-functional teams with high accuracy and follow-through.
- Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills to track down inputs, chase actions diplomatically, and maintain status updates across teams.
- Detail-Oriented & Dependable: High attention to detail regarding data entries/part numbers with a proactive approach to routine, business-critical change control tasks.
- Preferred Experience: Prior background in supply chain, operations, change control, or product management workflows (especially part setup and system maintenance) is highly advantageous.

Randstad CPE values diversity and promotes equality. No terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate against any of the protected characteristics that fall under the Equality Act 2010. We encourage and welcome applications from all sections of society and are more than happy to discuss reasonable adjustments and/or additional arrangements as required to support your application.

Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK.

For the purposes of the Conduct Regulations 2003, when advertising permanent vacancies we are acting as an Employment Agency, and when advertising temporary/contract vacancies we are acting as an Employment Business.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
If you love generating leads and thrive on seeing your marketing directly contribute to sales growth - This is your chance to take the lead.

We're looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Executive to own the marketing function within a growing family business that is a leading supplier of technical chemical solutions. It is a varied role spanning strategy, content, digital marketing, events, and automation

Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll be given the autonomy to shape marketing strategy, build powerful lead generation campaigns, and position the business as the go-to expert within its markets.

From LinkedIn campaigns and technical content to video production, CRM automation, SEO, events, and website optimisation, you'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery to create marketing that drives real commercial results.

With ambitious growth plans across the UK and Europe, we're looking for someone who can consistently attract qualified prospects, convert interest into opportunities, and help fuel the next stage of the company's success.

If you're commercially minded, creative, and passionate about generating leads that convert into customers, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver the annual digital marketing strategy.
- Drive qualified lead generation through multiple digital channels.
- Create engaging content including blogs, whitepapers, videos, case studies, and technical resources.
- Manage and grow the company's LinkedIn presence through thought leadership campaigns.
- Plan and execute email marketing campaigns and lead nurturing activities.
- Oversee website performance, SEO optimisation, and content updates.
- Support European market expansion through targeted digital campaigns.

Requirements
- Proven Experience in Digital Marketing
- Proven track record of generating qualified leads through digital channels.
- Experience creating and executing email marketing campaigns.
- Strong website management experience, ideally including Shopify.
- Experience using CRM and marketing automation platforms
- Strong content creation skills, including technical writing.
- Videography, photography, and video editing experience.

Highly Desirable:
- Marketing, Chemistry, or Science-related degree.
- Experience creating technical content or working within technical, manufacturing, engineering, chemical, or industrial sectors.
- Strong Understanding of AI and Marketing automation tools

Benefits
- Starting salary £35,000 - £40,000
- Huge opportunity to own, develop and grow the marketing function.
- High level of autonomy and responsibility.

Please note this is role is 100% office based and it is 40 hour working week but there is flexibility on start and finish times

Hybrid working may be an option further down the line but it is not envisaged will be practical initially.
